data.narrative:
Lilac Solutions is a Series C-stage Climate & Energy company that has raised $315M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a peer set of three same-sector, same-stage private companies (KoBold Metals at $3.0B, Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B, and Amogy at $700M), supplemented by a broader universe of eight private climate-tech comparables and one relevant public reference point.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yields $536M. Peer-median analysis across the three direct comparables produces a $1.0B midpoint, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. The wide dispersion among peers reflects heterogeneity in capital intensity, technology readiness, and market position within the climate-tech sector at this stage.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $455M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $768M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while peer comparables—particularly the KoBold outlier at $3.0B—establish the upper bound. Key uncertainties include the appropriate multiple for stage advancement in a volatile sector and the relevance of comparables spanning a threefold valuation range. Sensitivity to capital intensity assumptions and near-term commercialization milestones remains material.
